__inputs.name: VAR_APPINSIGHTS
__inputs.label: Application Insights resource ID
__inputs.description: The Application Insights resource with OTLP support that receives the traces and logs

title: h100-llm
description: Self-hosted Qwen3.8-27B on an Azure Spot H100 VM: token throughput and economics, gateway traffic, vLLM serving, GPU, host and telemetry pipeline.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Chat requests through LiteLLM in the selected time range.

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Share of LiteLLM requests that failed in the selected range.

panels.title: Input tokens/s
panels.description: Prompt (input) tokens per second across all requests now, prefix-cache hits included.

panels.title: Output tokens/s
panels.description: Generated (output) tokens per second across all requests now.

panels.title: Total tokens/s
panels.description: Input plus output tokens per second now.

panels.title: Request tok/s
panels.description: Output tokens per second one request sees now (1 / median inter-token latency).

panels.title: Concurrency
panels.description: Requests vLLM is serving now. The server runs at most 32 at once (--max-num-seqs); more wait in the queue.

panels.title: Model server
panels.description: Whether the collector's last scrape of vLLM /metrics succeeded. Off means no scrape in the last 5 minutes: the VM is stopped or evicted.

panels.title: VM hours
panels.description: Hours the model server was up in the selected range: the hours you pay the VM for.

panels.title: VM cost
panels.description: VM hours times the VM price variable.

panels.title: Token revenue
panels.description: What the tokens served in the selected range would sell for at the price variables: computed input, cached input and output priced separately.

panels.title: Revenue per VM hour
panels.description: Token revenue divided by VM hours. Compare it with the VM price per hour.

panels.title: Output tokens per VM hour
panels.description: Generated tokens per hour the VM was up, at the load it actually had.

panels.title: VM cost per 1M output
panels.description: What one million generated tokens cost in VM time at the load the VM had. Idle time raises it; a busier VM lowers it.

panels.title: Revenue per hour vs VM cost
panels.description: Hourly revenue rate at the price variables, stacked by token type; the dashed line is the VM price. Revenue above the line is margin.

options.content:
Prices are the dashboard variables at the top, in USD:

| Item | USD |
|---|---|
| VM | **${vm_usd_per_hour}** per hour |
| Input (computed) | **${price_input}** per 1M tokens |
| Input (prefix-cache hit) | **${price_cached_input}** per 1M tokens |
| Output | **${price_output}** per 1M tokens |

Token prices default to a public list price for Qwen3.8-27B in October 2026: $0.425 per 1M input tokens, $0.085 cached input and $2.55 output. Set them to the prices you want to compare against.

Token counts come from vLLM. Output includes reasoning tokens. VM hours count only minutes in which the model server answered its scrape.

Capacity reference (benchmark, real text, 512-token replies): about **1,550 output tokens/s** at 32 concurrent requests, **166 tokens/s** for a single request.

panels.title: Throughput: input, output and per request
Avg input/s
panels.description: Input tokens per second averaged over the selected range.

panels.title: Peak input/s
panels.description: Highest 1-minute input rate in the selected range, prefix-cache hits included.

panels.title: Avg output/s
panels.description: Output tokens per second averaged over the selected range.

panels.title: Peak output/s
panels.description: Highest 1-minute output rate in the selected range.

panels.title: Avg total/s
panels.description: Input plus output tokens per second averaged over the selected range.

panels.title: Peak total/s
panels.description: Highest 1-minute input-plus-output rate in the selected range.

panels.title: Input per output
panels.description: Input tokens per output token in the selected range. Agentic workloads resend long contexts, so this runs high.

panels.title: Input cached
panels.description: Share of input tokens served from the prefix cache instead of computed in prefill.

panels.title: Input tokens per second
panels.description: Prompt tokens per second, stacked: the top of the stack is the total input rate. Only the computed part costs GPU time; cache hits are reused KV blocks.

panels.title: Output tokens per second
panels.description: Generated tokens per second summed over every running request.

panels.title: Peak per-request output/s
panels.description: Highest 1-minute median speed one request saw in the selected range (1 / median inter-token latency). About 166 tok/s is the ceiling with no other load; long prompts being prefilled at the same time pull it down. Per-request maxima from the histograms are skewed by very short replies, so this uses the median.

panels.title: Per-request output speed
panels.description: Output tokens per second one request sees: 1 / inter-token latency. Falls as concurrency and prefill load rise.

panels.title: Concurrent requests
panels.description: Requests in progress. The dashed line is the 32-request limit (--max-num-seqs): above it requests wait for a slot. LiteLLM counts a request from arrival to its last byte, so it reads slightly higher.

panels.title: Input tokens per request
panels.description: Prompt length of finished requests.

panels.title: Output tokens per request
panels.description: Generated length of finished requests, reasoning included.

panels.title: Gateway input tokens
panels.description: Prompt tokens LiteLLM counted in the selected range. Should match vLLM's count.

panels.title: Gateway output tokens
panels.description: Completion tokens LiteLLM counted in the selected range, reasoning included.

panels.title: Reasoning share of output
panels.description: Share of output tokens spent thinking before the visible answer.

panels.title: Peak in flight
panels.description: Most requests LiteLLM held open at once in the selected range.

panels.title: p50 time to first token
panels.description: Median wait for the first streamed token, measured at the gateway.

panels.title: p95 end-to-end latency
panels.description: 95th percentile request duration at the gateway in the selected range.

panels.title: Gateway tokens per second
panels.description: Tokens per second counted by LiteLLM when each request finishes (input on the right axis). Requests are counted at the end, so this is burstier than vLLM's rates.

panels.title: Gateway time to first token
panels.description: Time from the client's request to the first streamed token, gateway included.

panels.title: Requests by HTTP status
panels.description: Gateway requests per second by response status.

panels.title: End-to-end latency (gateway)
panels.description: Request duration measured at LiteLLM. Long generations dominate p95.

panels.title: Time to first token
panels.description: Queueing plus prefill, measured by vLLM.

panels.title: Time per output token
panels.description: Gap between output tokens during decode. Rises with concurrency.

panels.title: KV cache usage
panels.description: Share of KV cache blocks in use. Near 100% vLLM starts preempting requests.

panels.title: Speculative decoding acceptance
panels.description: Share of MTP draft tokens the model accepted. Higher means more tokens per forward pass.

panels.title: Finished requests by reason
panels.description: Why generations ended. 'length' means max_tokens cut the answer short.

panels.title: Prefix cache hit rate
panels.description: Share of prompt tokens served from the prefix cache instead of recomputed.

panels.title: Preemptions per second
panels.description: Requests evicted from the KV cache under memory pressure. Should stay at 0.

panels.title: GPU and SM activity
panels.description: GPU busy counts any running kernel; SM and tensor-core activity show how much of the chip does work.

panels.title: Power
panels.description: Board power against the enforced limit.

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: GPU die and HBM memory temperature.

panels.title: GPU memory
panels.description: Framebuffer in use. vLLM reserves most of it for the KV cache at start-up, so this stays flat.

panels.title: Throttled time
panels.description: Share of time clocks were held down, by cause.

panels.title: Xid errors
panels.description: GPU Xid errors in the selected range. Any Xid deserves a look at the host kernel log.

panels.title: GPU health
panels.description: Worst DCGM health-watch result. Warn (10) appears with power throttling under normal load; Fail (20) needs action.

panels.title: Host CPU and memory
panels.description: Host CPU busy share and memory in use (page cache excluded).

panels.title: Container CPU
panels.description: CPU cores used per container.

panels.title: Container memory
panels.description: Memory per container. vLLM holds model weights in host memory while loading.

panels.title: Disk usage
panels.description: Used share per filesystem. /data holds the model weights and Docker.

panels.title: Host network
panels.description: Bytes per second across host interfaces. Model downloads show up as large receive spikes.

panels.title: Container restarts
panels.description: Restarts per container within each interval. 'None' means no container restarted.

panels.title: Spans and logs exported
panels.description: Items per second the collector sent to App Insights.

panels.title: Metric points exported
panels.description: Points per second sent to the Azure Monitor workspace.

panels.title: Export queue fill
panels.description: Share of the persistent sending queue in use. Growth means Azure is rejecting data or unreachable.

panels.title: LLM calls (traces)
panels.description: One row per model call, from the LiteLLM spans in Application Insights: duration, time to first token, token counts and why generation stopped. Errors carry no token counts. Open the trace ID in Application Insights or Grafana Explore for the whole request.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name startswith "chat "
| extend d = customDimensions
| project Time = timestamp,
    ['Result'] = iff(tobool(success), "ok", "error"),
    ['Duration'] = duration / 1000.0,
    ['Time to first token'] = todouble(d["gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk"]),
    ['Input tokens'] = tolong(d["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]),
    ['Output tokens'] = tolong(d["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"]),
    ['Finish reason'] = tostring(todynamic(tostring(d["gen_ai.response.finish_reasons"]))[0]),
    ['Trace ID'] = operation_Id
| order by Time desc
| take 200

panels.title: Model server log (vLLM engine stats and warnings)
panels.description: vLLM's own log lines from the model container, shipped by the collector's filelog receiver: the engine stats it prints every 10 seconds, plus any warning or error.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
traces
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where tostring(customDimensions["service"]) == "local-llm"
| where message has "Avg prompt throughput" or severityLevel >= 2
| project timestamp,
    Message = trim_end(@"\s+", coalesce(extract(@"(Engine \d+: [^\r\n]*)", 1, message), message)),
    level = case(severityLevel >= 3, "error", severityLevel == 2, "warning", "info")
| order by timestamp desc
| take 300
